personality_one_liner: A cinematic, jewel-encrusted sorting experience with translucent glass surfaces and gleaming gemstone crystals on deep obsidian depths.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous vertical breathing room with strict safe-area adherence and compact floating status bars.

do's: Use frosted glass panels for headers, tube containers, and level completion modals
Apply translucent jewel trays with subtle borders
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AAA standards over glass surfaces
dont's: Avoid low-contrast text on transparent glass
Do not blur interactive buttons without solid tint backing

screens.name: LevelSelect
screens.purpose: Display all 10 curated progressive sorting levels with completion badges and quick access.

states.loading: Centered translucent spinner over deep obsidian canvas.
states.empty: No levels found card with retry button.
states.error: Error message banner with retry action.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll view featuring a cinematic header, level progression grid with glass cards, stars earned, move records, and direct touch launch.

screens.name: GamePlay
screens.purpose: The core puzzle sorting board where players tap tubes to lift, move, and sort sparkling gemstone crystals.

states.loading: Initializing puzzle board with animated crystal generator.
states.error: Invalid move notification with haptic feedback.

screens.layout: Immersive dark canvas with top status header (level, move counter, undo, restart), central responsive tube grid with glass styling and glowing crystal stacks, and bottom sticky control dock.

screens.name: LevelComplete
screens.purpose: Celebratory modal overlay displaying victory stars, moves taken, best record, and next level action.
screens.layout: Centered frosted glass sheet with glowing gem iconography, performance stats, and tactile primary CTA buttons for Next Level and Level Select.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build Jewel Sort Puzzle as a fully functional, highly polished React Native mobile puzzle game using Expo, React Native Reanimated, and Gesture Handler.
Implement 10 manually curated, resolvable levels with progressive difficulty (ruby, emerald, sapphire, amethyst, topaz gemstones).

Ensure flawless tube tap interaction: tapping a tube selects the top jewel with a smooth lift animation, tapping another moves it if valid (empty or same color match), otherwise animates back with a soft spring.
Include local storage progress saving (AsyncStorage), undo functionality, move counter, and level restart.
Adhere strictly to the Glass / Luxe DARK personality palette with deep obsidian background (#0C0E14), frosted glass containers, glowing gemstone aesthetics, and zero banned colors.
Ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe area insets are fully respected across all screens.
